skills.description: Batch image processing tool supporting remove background (抠图), replace background (换背景), add watermark (水印), and resize/crop (尺寸裁剪). Uses a local Python CLI (image_studio.py) backed by rembg + Pillow — no API keys or network required after dependency install.
